text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove keeps nodding off during
training
today...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. Could you repeat that
explanation
once more?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been getting much sleep lately.
The
student council work keeps piling
up.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫？調子が悪そうだ
大丈夫？調子が悪そうだよ

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I decided to do a little before bed, but
before I
realized it, the sun was up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All the same, the work needs to be
done. Don't
worry—none of this should
be of your concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove casually brushes it off, but
she's
clearly exhausted. I should keep
this in mind.
